newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values firm, soy weak.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values firm, soy weak.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers were slightly higher in reaction to increased export interest for July and August positions, grain dealers said.
Soybean values eased for nearby positions as exporters tried to keep U.S. soybeans competitively priced with Brazilian soybeans.
Soft red winter wheat values were higher in reaction to belief that export demand will increase soon. Exporters await a tender from Egypt, which they said needs wheat for August and September.
Hard red winter wheat values were unchanged.
The HRW wheat harvest continued to produce large yields, but farmer and grain elevators continued to store much of the grain.
